# Generated by iptables-save v1.8.9 on Thu Jul 30 09:00:00 2026
# Web host that "blocks ICMP for security" — the icmp DROP sits before the
# conntrack accept, so fragmentation-needed dies and PMTUD black-holes.
*filter
:INPUT DROP [0:0]
:FORWARD DROP [0:0]
:OUTPUT ACCEPT [0:0]
-A INPUT -i lo -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -s 127.0.0.0/8 ! -i lo -j DROP
-A INPUT -p icmp -j DROP
-A INPUT -m conntrack --ctstate RELATED,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -m conntrack --ctstate INVALID -j DROP
-A INPUT -p tcp -m tcp --dport 80 -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -p tcp -m tcp --dport 443 -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -m limit --limit 5/min -j LOG --log-prefix "DROP-INPUT: "
-A FORWARD -m conntrack --ctstate INVALID -j DROP
-A FORWARD -i eth1 -o eth0 -s 192.168.10.0/24 -j ACCEPT
-A FORWARD -m limit --limit 5/min -j LOG --log-prefix "DROP-FWD: "
COMMIT
